# 2021 Global Opportunities Report

Report 061 | Published 2021-07-05 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2021-7-5/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/061.json)

Country valuations and external balance sheets.

The five-year country recommendations are now testable in horizon, but their risk-adjustment rule is unspecified. USD proxies show a highly uneven record: China and Indonesia lost value; Russia suffered an investment-access failure; Taiwan and Poland strongly gained. The supposedly low-ranked US beat most favored countries. The sound balance-sheet distinction between gross debt and net assets does not by itself predict equity returns. NIIP explanations need valuation effects as well as current-account flows.

**Coverage:** Read the entire web article and image labels. The separately referenced Global Opportunities PDF is not included in this input and has not been assumed read. All thirteen named country rankings are represented individually, with five-year USD ETF comparisons and risk limitations.

### 061-C19

**Dollar debt amplifies stress**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | dollar-debt-mismatch |
| Source blocks | 26 |
| Thesis family | dollar-debt-mismatch |

The narrow balance-sheet mechanism is arithmetic. It does not mean every dollar rally inevitably causes a crisis, since hedges, reserves and export revenues can offset exposure.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Deductive assessment:**

- Fixed unhedged dollar debt service D; exchange rate e in local currency per dollar rises; local revenues held fixed.

Local debt service = e*D; its increase is D*change(e), reducing cash available after debt service.

**Outcome evidence:**

BEA defines the position as external financial assets minus external liabilities. It includes direct-investment claims, not a simple sum of physically located real estate.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [International investment position methodology and outcomes](https://apps.bea.gov/scb/issues/2025/07-july/0725-international-investment-position.htm) | BEA | 2025-07-14 | Verified in the audit

Net IIP is external assets less liabilities. Changes include transactions, market-price changes, exchange rates and other volume changes; Q1 2025 US net IIP improved $1.92 tn despite net financial inflows as valuation effects dominated.
